name: Inline
usage: Buttons, tags, icons and text side by side; with a Spacer, pushing the rest to the right

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between children, as a spacing step.

props.name: padding
props.description: Padding on all sides, as a spacing step; no padding when omitted.

props.name: justify
props.description: Horizontal distribution of the children; `between` pushes the first and last children to the two ends.

props.name: wrap
props.description: Wraps onto new lines when there is not enough space (groups of tags or buttons).

props.name: grow
props.description: Takes up the remaining space in a parent Stack or Inline.
